newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar holds around days lows in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar holds around days lows in late trading.

text.p: White sugar futures remained at or near the day's lows in the late afternoon but trading showed little sign of picking-up from its earlier slow pace.
Near March last traded at $304.50 a tonne, down $3.10 from Wednesday, while other positions were upt $4.10 a tonne lower. Turnover totalled 1,283 lots.
Paris white sugar was $2.50 down for March and May, both ending at $404.00.
Earlier in the day continued buying by one leading trade house was not enough to outpace the wealth of sellers determined to drag March lower, traders said.
in physicals some news emerged on this week's Iraqi buying tender as Jordanian traders said Iraq was still evaluating more than 120 offers from international suppliers.
But a final decision may not be taken before early next week as the extent of Iraqi puchases will depend on prices.
